read_xml_read_xml_file: read an XML file into a pandas DataFrame using an XPath expression
read_xml_parse_namespaced_xml: parse an XML document with namespaces using XPath and namespace mapping
read_xml_iterparse_large_xml: iterparse a large XML file for memory-efficient row extraction
read_xml_transform_xslt: transform an XML document with an XSLT stylesheet before parsing into a DataFrame
read_xml_parse_attributes_only: parse only XML attributes at the specified XPath into a DataFrame
